from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import datetime, hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys

ROOT=Path('/Users/systemsystems/.codex/worktrees/s196/OODS-Forge')
OUT=ROOT/'artifacts/product-reality/sprint-196/m07/closeout/accounting-preliminary'
B='63efd098cc1def448014a1da09d64394dd3dfaf7'
REVIEW='751fe32ed3e50c9af32fc7feb74ce5edb1bb4dd9'
BASE='6e779776a7efa3b6e7b26a12966f0c4186dba1d6'
SUITES=['viz-core','viz-render','mcp-server','root-core','component-packages']
start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
sha=lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=ROOT)
def load(path):
    return json.loads((ROOT/path).read_text())
def ref(path):
    data=(ROOT/path).read_bytes()
    return {'path':str(path),'sha256':sha(data),'bytes':len(data)}
def verify_ref(r):
    assert ref(r['path'])==r,r
    assert git('show',REVIEW+':'+r['path'])==(ROOT/r['path']).read_bytes(),r['path']
def normalized(s):
    return 'skipped' if s in ['pending','disabled','skipped'] else s

def raw_projection(raw,workspace):
    files={}
    for file in raw['testResults']:
        name=file['name']
        file_path=os.path.relpath(name if os.path.isabs(name) else os.path.join(workspace,name),workspace)
        assert not file_path.startswith('../') and file_path not in files
        seen=Counter(); assertions={}
        for assertion in file.get('assertionResults',[]):
            name=assertion.get('fullName',' '.join(assertion.get('ancestorTitles',[])+[assertion['title']]))
            key=name+'#'+str(seen[name]);seen[name]+=1
            state=normalized(assertion['status'])
            assert state in ['passed','failed','skipped','todo']
            assertions[key]={'status':state,'failureMessages':assertion.get('failureMessages',[])}
        files[file_path]={'status':normalized(file['status']),'assertions':assertions}
    counts=Counter(a['status'] for f in files.values() for a in f['assertions'].values())
    expected={'total':sum(counts.values()),**{k:counts[k] for k in ['passed','failed','skipped','todo']}}
    assert expected=={'total':raw['numTotalTests'],'passed':raw['numPassedTests'],'failed':raw['numFailedTests'],'skipped':raw['numPendingTests'],'todo':raw['numTodoTests']}
    return files,expected

def source_at(head,file):
    result=subprocess.run(['git','show',head+':'+file],cwd=ROOT,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if result.returncode:
        assert b'does not exist' in result.stderr or b'exists on disk, but not in' in result.stderr
        return {'head':head,'path':file,'exists':False}
    return {'head':head,'path':file,'exists':True,'bytes':len(result.stdout),'sha256':sha(result.stdout)}

accounting=load('artifacts/product-reality/sprint-196/m07/closeout/accounting-preliminary/suite-accounting.json')
assert accounting['executionHead']==B and accounting['reviewHead']==REVIEW
assert accounting['status']=='passed' and not accounting['validationIssues']
assert not accounting['unattributedDeltas'] and not accounting['unusedAttributions']
assert not accounting['closeoutAttempts'] and not accounting['closeoutFailures']
assert subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',B,REVIEW],cwd=ROOT).returncode==0
changes=git('diff','--name-status','--no-renames','-z',B,REVIEW).decode().split('\0')
assert changes.pop()=='' and len(changes)%2==0
change_rows=[{'status':changes[i],'path':changes[i+1]} for i in range(0,len(changes),2)]
assert change_rows==accounting['headRelation']['changedEvidencePaths']
for r in change_rows:
    assert r['status']=='A',r
    assert re.fullmatch(r'artifacts/product-reality/sprint-196/m07/(?:(?:five-suite-closeout[^/]*|closeout|ci)/.*\.(?:json|log|md)|final-archive/.*\.(?:json|log|md|sha256)|movers/.*\.(?:json|log|md|patch|txt)|e2e-node(?:20|24)\.json)',r['path']),r
for r in accounting['references']:verify_ref(r)

projections={}; suite_records=[]; input_refs=[]; aggregate_records=[]
for cohort,sprint,head in [('sprint195Closeout','sprint-195',BASE),('closeout','sprint-196',B)]:
    prefix=f'artifacts/product-reality/{sprint}/m07/five-suite-closeout'
    aggregate_path=prefix+'/four-suite-baseline.json'
    agg=load(aggregate_path)
    assert agg['measuredHead']==head and agg['status']=='passed'
    assert agg['suiteSelection']=='all' and not agg['namedRetry'] and len(agg['runs'])==1
    assert agg['cleanBeforeSetup']['clean'] and agg['cleanAfterSetup']['clean']
    suites=agg['runs'][0]['suites']
    assert [row['suite'] for row in suites]==SUITES
    aggregate_records.append({'cohort':cohort,'head':head,'aggregate':ref(aggregate_path),'host':agg['host'],'configuredTestTimeoutMs':agg['configuredTestTimeoutMs']})
    for embedded in suites:
        suite=embedded['suite'];receipt_path=prefix+'/run-1/'+suite+'.json'
        raw_path=prefix+'/run-1/'+suite+'.vitest.json';log_path=prefix+'/run-1/'+suite+'.log'
        receipt=load(receipt_path);raw=load(raw_path)
        assert receipt['measuredHead']==head and receipt['exitCode']==0
        assert receipt['cleanBefore']['clean'] and receipt['cleanAfter']['clean']
        assert embedded['receipt']['sha256']==ref(receipt_path)['sha256']
        assert receipt['log']['sha256']==ref(log_path)['sha256']
        files,counts=raw_projection(raw,agg['workspace'])
        assert counts==receipt['vitest']['tests']
        assert counts['failed']==0 and counts['todo']==0
        execution=next(e for e in accounting['executions'] if e['cohort']==cohort and e['suite']==suite)
        assert execution['counts']==counts
        assert execution['fileCounts']['total']==len(files)
        assert execution['rawReport']==ref(raw_path)
        skipped=[{'file':file,'testKey':key,'status':a['status']} for file,f in files.items() for key,a in f['assertions'].items() if a['status']=='skipped']
        skipped.sort(key=lambda x:(x['file'],x['testKey']))
        projections[(cohort,suite)]=files
        suite_records.append({'cohort':cohort,'suite':suite,'head':head,'literalCommand':receipt['literalCommand'],'executedCommand':receipt['executedCommand'],'tests':counts,'files':len(files),'skippedIdentities':skipped,'receipt':ref(receipt_path),'rawReport':ref(raw_path),'log':ref(log_path)})
        input_refs.extend([ref(receipt_path),ref(raw_path),ref(log_path)])

validated_deltas=[];source_cache={};summary=[]
for suite in SUITES:
    old=projections[('sprint195Closeout',suite)];new=projections[('closeout',suite)]
    before=next(r for r in suite_records if r['cohort']=='sprint195Closeout' and r['suite']==suite)
    after=next(r for r in suite_records if r['cohort']=='closeout' and r['suite']==suite)
    assert before['skippedIdentities']==after['skippedIdentities'],suite
    comparison=next(c for c in accounting['comparisons'] if c['suite']==suite)
    assert comparison['beforeCounts']==before['tests'] and comparison['afterCounts']==after['tests']
    expected={}
    for file in sorted(set(old)|set(new)):
        old_file=old.get(file);new_file=new.get(file)
        oa=old_file['assertions'] if old_file else {};na=new_file['assertions'] if new_file else {}
        added=sorted(set(na)-set(oa));removed=sorted(set(oa)-set(na))
        status_deltas=[{'key':k,'before':oa[k]['status'],'after':na[k]['status'],'beforeFailureMessages':oa[k]['failureMessages'],'afterFailureMessages':na[k]['failureMessages']} for k in sorted(set(oa)&set(na)) if oa[k]['status']!=na[k]['status']]
        if old_file is None or new_file is None or added or removed or status_deltas or old_file['status']!=new_file['status']:
            expected[file]={'addedAssertions':added,'removedAssertions':removed,'changedStatuses':status_deltas}
    assert set(expected)=={d['file'] for d in comparison['fileDeltas']}
    for delta in comparison['fileDeltas']:
        file=delta['file'];actual=expected[file]
        for k in ['addedAssertions','removedAssertions']:assert sorted(delta[k])==actual[k],(file,k)
        assert sorted(delta['changedStatuses'],key=lambda x:x['key'])==actual['changedStatuses']
        attribution=delta['attribution'];assert attribution['kind']=='changed-test-file'
        if file not in source_cache:
            actual_commits=git('log','--format=%H',BASE+'..'+B,'--',file).decode().splitlines()
            assert actual_commits,file
            source_cache[file]={'file':file,'before':source_at(BASE,file),'after':source_at(B,file),'actualFileChangingCommits':actual_commits}
            assert source_cache[file]['before']!=source_cache[file]['after']
            for commit in actual_commits:
                assert subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',commit,B],cwd=ROOT).returncode==0
                touched=git('diff-tree','--no-commit-id','--name-only','-r','--no-renames','-z',commit).decode().split('\0')
                assert file in touched,(commit,file)
        assert {r['commit'] for r in attribution['references']}==set(source_cache[file]['actualFileChangingCommits'])
        assert all(r['path']==file for r in attribution['references'])
        validated_deltas.append({'suite':suite,'file':file,**actual,'source':source_cache[file]})
    summary.append({'suite':suite,'before':before['tests'],'after':after['tests'],'netAssertionChange':after['tests']['total']-before['tests']['total'],'fileDeltas':len(expected),'addedAssertions':sum(len(d['addedAssertions']) for d in expected.values()),'removedAssertions':sum(len(d['removedAssertions']) for d in expected.values()),'skipIdentitiesUnchanged':True})
